title: Arthur Young, Puharich and the seances with the Nine

tellings.quote: Booharic as well and he was involved in some of those seances with the nine

plain: From the 1950s into the 1970s, a group of people in the United States held séances in which they believed they were in touch with "the Nine", a group of beings speaking from beyond ordinary reality, and a man named Arthur Young and a researcher named Andrija Puharich are said to have taken part. Michels mentions this in passing, in a conversation with the parapsychologist Jeffrey Mishlove, without saying what the Nine told them or where he heard it.
